storeInfo.name: Azteca Market
storeInfo.tagline: Auténtica comida mexicana y abacería tradicional en Bridgeport

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del mercado.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the market.
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en la calle y lote trasero.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Street parking and rear lot available.

products.descriptionEs: Aguacate Hass fresco machacado al momento con tomate, cebolla, cilantro, chile jalapeño y jugo de limón fresco.
products.descriptionEn: Freshly smashed Hass avocado with ripe tomatoes, onions, cilantro, jalapeño, and fresh lime juice.

products.descriptionEs: Mezcla de quesos mexicanos fundidos al horno con auténtico chorizo casero, servido con tortillas de maíz calientes.
products.descriptionEn: Melted Mexican cheeses baked with authentic homemade chorizo, served with warm corn tortillas.

products.descriptionEs: Tres masa gruesa de maíz ligeramente frita, cubierta con frijoles refritos, lechuga, crema, queso fresco y tu elección de carne.
products.descriptionEn: Three thick, lightly fried corn masa bases topped with refried beans, lettuce, crema, fresh cheese, and your choice of meat.
Marinated al pastor pork tacos with roasted pineapple, cilantro, and finely diced onions on handmade corn tortillas.
Giant flour tortilla stuffed with tender grilled steak, Mexican rice, black beans, melted cheese, and sour cream.
Three shredded chicken enchiladas smothered in homemade red sauce, topped with fresh cheese and Mexican crema.
Thin cuts of marinated grilled steak served with a cheese enchilada, guacamole, pot beans, and grilled spring onions.
Tender chicken piece smothered in our complex and aromatic mole sauce made from dried chilis, spices, and chocolate.
Crispy bolillo roll stuffed with tender pork carnitas, drowned in spicy chile de árbol sauce and pickled red onions.
Traditional handcrafted Mexican beverage made with rice, milk, vanilla, and a touch of cinnamon.
Refreshing infusion of natural hibiscus flowers, lightly sweetened and served ice-cold.
Authentic Mexican soda sweetened with pure cane sugar. Flavors: Mandarin, Grapefruit, Tamarind, or Pineapple.

products.descriptionEs: Tortillas de maíz hechas a mano rellenas de flor de calabaza salteada con epazote, cebolla y queso Oaxaca fundido.
products.descriptionEn: Handmade corn tortillas stuffed with squash blossom sautéed with epazote, onions, and melted Oaxaca cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Camarones jumbo en una refrescante salsa de tomate picante con aguacate fresco, cilantro, cebolla y jugo de limón.
products.descriptionEn: Jumbo shrimp in a refreshing spicy tomato sauce with fresh avocado, cilantro, onions, and lime juice.

products.descriptionEs: Dos tostadas crujientes con frijoles refritos, pollo desmenuzado en salsa de chipotle, crema agria y queso fresco.
products.descriptionEn: Two crispy tostadas topped with refried beans, chipotle-shredded chicken, sour cream, and fresh cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Tortillas pasadas por una salsa cremosa de frijol negro, rellenas de queso fresco y bañadas con crema y aguacate.
products.descriptionEn: Tortillas dipped in a creamy black bean sauce, stuffed with fresh cheese and topped with cream and avocado.

products.nameEs: Pechuga de Pollo en Salsa de Mango y Habanero
products.nameEn: Chicken Breast in Mango Habanero Sauce
products.descriptionEs: Jugosa pechuga de pollo a la plancha cubierta con una salsa dulce y picante de mango fresco y chile habanero.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy grilled chicken breast topped with a sweet and spicy fresh mango and habanero pepper sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Fina capa de filete de res empanizado y crujiente, servido con papas fritas caseras, arroz rojo y ensalada fresca.
products.descriptionEn: Thin, crispy breaded beef cutlet served with homemade french fries, red rice, and a fresh salad.

products.nameEs: Tacos de Pescado al Estilo Baja (3 pzas)
products.descriptionEs: Pescado rebozado y frito en tortillas de maíz, coronado con ensalada de repollo crujiente y aderezo de chipotle.
products.descriptionEn: Beer-battered fried fish in corn tortillas, topped with crunchy cabbage slaw and chipotle mayo dressing.

products.descriptionEs: Tradicional caldo espeso de maíz pozolero con carne de cerdo tierna, servido con lechuga, rábanos y orégano.
products.descriptionEn: Traditional rich hominy soup with tender pork, served with shredded lettuce, radishes, and oregano.

products.descriptionEs: Carne de res cocinada a fuego lento durante horas en un caldo de chiles secos y especias, servida con cebolla y cilantro.
products.descriptionEn: Beef shank slow-cooked for hours in a rich broth of dried chilies and spices, served with onions and cilantro.

products.descriptionEs: Chiles poblanos asados, rellenos de carne picada sazonada con frutas secas, cubiertos con un ligero capeado de huevo.
products.descriptionEn: Roasted poblano peppers stuffed with seasoned ground beef and dried fruits, coated in a light egg batter.

products.descriptionEs: Refrescante bebida artesanal elaborada diariamente con pulpa de tamarindo natural y un toque perfecto de dulzor.
products.descriptionEn: Refreshing homemade beverage prepared daily with natural tamarind pulp and a perfect touch of sweetness.
Ground coffee brewed in a clay pot with natural unrefined cane sugar and an aromatic cinnamon stick.

products.descriptionEs: Deliciosa mezcla de limón fresco, néctar de agave y puré de maracuyá, servida en vaso escarchado con sal y chile.
products.descriptionEn: Delicious blend of fresh lime, agave nectar, and passion fruit puree, served in a salt and chili-rimmed glass.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con tacos vegetarianos, guacamole fresco y varias opciones preparadas con tortillas de maíz 100% naturales.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer vegetarian tacos, fresh guacamole, and several options made with 100% natural corn tortillas.

faqs.qEs: ¿Tienen servicio de abacería y mercado además del restaurante?
faqs.qEn: Do you have a grocery market section in addition to the restaurant?
faqs.aEs: ¡Así es! Contamos con una sección de productos hispanos, especias, quesos y artículos tradicionales mexicanos.
faqs.aEn: That's right! We feature a grocery section with Hispanic products, spices, cheeses, and traditional Mexican goods.

faqs.qEn: Do you accept phone orders for pickup?
faqs.aEs: Sí, puede llamar directamente a nuestro local para preparar su pedido con anticipación.
faqs.aEn: Yes, you can call our store directly to have your order prepared in advance.
